loss_aggregation: Production step_terms and counterfactual loss; active-frame means; original weights; frame state detach.
gradient_clip: One global factor after full weighted total; component effective norms use that same factor.
inactive_terms: Absent from gradients; None means disconnected; connected exact zero recorded separately.
zero_gradient_control: Connected gradients zeroed, None remains None; retained AdamW momentum and weight decay.
functional_contrast: Predicted odd-minus-even class mean versus pooled physical template1-minus-template0.
semantic_predicates: Detached hard predicates intentionally have no derivative; location straight-through gradient is a surrogate.
decision_scope: Local gradient direction and disposable same-batch response only; no continuation or model selection.
